panels.caption: Zoho CRM — Approval Processes list (no process in this org)

rows: The list has a Module column with an "All Modules" filter. This org has no approval process, so a module name in a row could not be seen.
Shows the raw module ID "a26a20be-8b90-49cc-9af4-99dde65a4a54". The process page header shows "Module a26a20be-…" too.
Process whose module no longer exists
"Add New Company" (13 Aug 2026) is still switched on. Its module was removed: GET /api/v1/modules/a26a20be-… returns 404, and every current module was created on 29 Oct 2026.
